items.title: Percy Gabriel Interview, 1987-07-10
items.q: Old Tom Copen, another bass player. I've been trying to think of him. I remember he was playing for a win on Corn Eye... He used to take me around... He used to try to get me to join a WPA band.

ctx.x: I said, I'm nice waiting instead of me grabbing like them.

No. They grabbing that one meatball left. And I'm surprised. If I wouldn't have reached for that, but I wouldn't have got that one meatball. So I come back. I was telling my brother Clarence about it. He said, look, next time you get out there, you reach. When they reach, you reach with both hands. See, because that's the way they're all. They'll eat up everything you install. Yeah. Yeah. But I learned a lot from those fellas, you know. Old Tom Copen, another bass player. I've been trying to think of him. I…
They had several of them. Not Vince Facturo, Louis Dumaine.
